extra_vocab.zh: 被捲入、深陷其中（get caught up in）；趕上進度（be all caught up）
extra_vocab.en: to become so involved in something that it is hard to stop or think about other things
extra_vocab.note: 文章用 get caught up in an endless cycle of responsibilities，指被工作與期待一直推著走、身不由己地深陷其中，帶有「不知不覺被捲進去」的語感。單獨說 I'm all caught up 則是另一個意思：進度已經跟上了。
extra_vocab.pattern: get / be caught up in + N（或 V-ing）
extra_vocab.grammar_note: get／be caught up in（被捲入）的介系詞固定用 in，後接名詞或 V-ing；get 強調「變成被捲入」的過程，be 強調目前的狀態。若是「趕上進度」的 caught up，才搭配 on 或 with（caught up on emails）。

examples.en: I was caught up in a long meeting and missed your call.
examples.zh: 我被一場很長的會議絆住，沒接到你的電話。

examples.en: Many small firms got caught up in the price war.
examples.zh: 許多小公司被捲入了價格戰。

examples.en: Try not to get caught up in small details during planning.
examples.zh: 規劃階段請盡量不要陷在小細節裡。

examples.en: Give me an hour, and I will be all caught up.
examples.zh: 給我一個小時，我的進度就會全部跟上。

similar.diff: tied up 是忙得抽不開身，多指時間被占住；caught up in 強調被捲入、深陷其中。

example.en: Mr. Park is tied up in a client meeting until noon.
example.zh: 朴先生在客戶會議中忙到中午才有空。

similar.diff: absorbed in 是專注投入、多為正面；caught up in 帶有身不由己的被捲入感。

example.en: She was so absorbed in the data that she forgot lunch.
example.zh: 她太專注在數據上，連午餐都忘了。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近，catch up on 是主動「補上落後的進度」；caught up in 是被動「被捲進去」。
confusable.usage: catch up on + 事情（補上進度）是主動動作；get caught up in 是被動，表示被捲入。

example.en: I need to catch up on my emails after the business trip.
example.zh: 出差回來後，我需要補看積壓的電子郵件。

extra_vocab.zh: catch 的過去式與過去分詞：抓住、趕上、染上、聽懂；get caught up in＝被捲入、深陷
extra_vocab.en: past form of catch; in "caught up in", it means so busy or involved in something that it is hard to stop
extra_vocab.note: 文章的 get caught up in 裡，caught 是 catch 的過去分詞（get + 過去分詞，表示被動），單字本身是「被抓住」的意思；加上 up in 才形成「被日常責任拖著走、深陷其中」的片語義。完整片語用法請看 caught up 的詳解。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: caught 不是原形，原形是 catch；過去式與過去分詞同形，都是 caught（catch–caught–caught），不是 catched。get／be caught up in 是被動語態，in 後面接名詞或 V-ing。

example.en: She catches the 7:30 train to the Taipei office every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上搭 7:30 的火車去台北辦公室。

example.en: We are catching a flight to Tokyo for the sales meeting.
example.zh: 我們要搭飛機去東京參加業務會議。

example.en: Please wait here while I catch up with the sales team.
example.zh: 我去追上業務團隊，請在這裡等一下。

example.en: I need two hours to catch up on unread emails.
example.zh: 我需要兩小時處理未讀的電子郵件。

example.en: The new logo caught the customers' attention right away.
example.zh: 新標誌立刻吸引了顧客的注意。

example.en: We must leave early to catch the 6 a.m. flight.
example.zh: 我們得早點出發才趕得上早上六點的班機。

example.en: We were caught in traffic and arrived ten minutes late.
example.zh: 我們遇上塞車，遲到了十分鐘。

examples.en: Many managers get caught up in daily tasks and forget long-term plans.
examples.zh: 許多主管被日常工作纏住，忘了長期計畫。

examples.en: Sorry for the late reply. I was caught up in a client meeting.
examples.zh: 抱歉這麼晚回覆，我剛被客戶會議絆住了。

examples.en: The team was caught in the rain on the way to the factory.
examples.zh: 團隊在前往工廠的路上遇到下雨。

examples.en: After the holiday, it took us a week to get caught up.
examples.zh: 假期後，我們花了一週才趕上進度。

examples.en: He caught the last flight to Tokyo after the meeting ended.
examples.zh: 會議結束後，他趕上了飛往東京的最後一班飛機。

examples.en: We have caught most of the errors before the final review.
examples.zh: 在最後審查前，我們已經抓出大部分的錯誤。

examples.en: Our shipment was caught in customs for three days.
examples.zh: 我們的貨物被海關扣留了三天。

confusable.diff: taught 是 teach（教）的過去式；caught 是 catch 的過去式，兩個字拼法和發音都很像。

example.en: Our manager taught us how to handle difficult customers.
example.zh: 我們的經理教我們如何應付難搞的客戶。

confusable.diff: court 是名詞，指法院；caught 是動詞，發音相近但意思完全不同。

example.en: The company will take the case to court next month.
example.zh: 公司下個月會把這個案子告上法院。

example.en: Please grab a seat and wait for the manager.
example.zh: 請找個位子坐下，等經理過來。

example.en: The ad captured the attention of many young buyers.
example.zh: 這則廣告吸引了許多年輕買家的注意。

example.en: Heavy rain trapped dozens of travelers at the airport.
example.zh: 大雨把數十位旅客困在機場。

derived.link: catch + -y，像 sunny、rainy 變成形容詞；容易「抓住」人耳朵的

example.en: The auditor caught a mistake in the quarterly report.
example.zh: 稽核員發現季報中有一個錯誤。

example.en: The price looks low, but there is a catch.
example.zh: 價格看起來很低，但其中有陷阱。

senses.zh: 被抓住、被捲入（caught up in）
senses.en: to become so involved in something that you cannot easily stop

example.en: The team got caught up in a long argument about the budget.
example.zh: 團隊陷入一場關於預算的長時間爭論。

senses.en: to get on a bus, train or flight in time
senses.distinguish: 受詞是交通工具或班次時，就是趕搭的意思。

example.en: We have to hurry to catch the last train home.
example.zh: 我們得趕緊搭上回家的最後一班火車。

senses.distinguish: 受詞是 a cold、the flu 等疾病時用這個意思。

example.en: He caught a cold during the business trip.
example.zh: 他在出差期間感冒了。

senses.en: to hear or understand what someone says
senses.distinguish: 受詞是別人說的話或名字時用這個意思。

example.en: Sorry, I didn't catch your name. Could you repeat it?
example.zh: 抱歉，我沒聽清楚你的名字，可以再說一次嗎？
